# Occupancy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Occupancy`](gmeow-Occupancy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Occupancy>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A measurement of the current number of entities located at or within a location. The location is the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md); the result is a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md). Typically computed by the solver layer from [`locatedAt`](../properties/gmeow-locatedAt.md) relationships and active [`LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md) instances (P12), but may also be asserted directly from sensor readings or manual counts.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

Use [`gmeow:Occupancy`](gmeow-Occupancy.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
